title: 北都执行风险仍在：京东提前入驻，大学城招标年底能否接棒？
speaker: Michelle Kwok

segments.en: It's certainly an ambitious plan just given the numbers that you just highlighted there. We've had seen in the past Hong Kong try to build up these sort of tech parks, right?
segments.zh: 仅凭你刚才提到的大数字，这确实是个雄心勃勃的计划。过去香港也尝试建设这类科技园区，对吧？

segments.en: Whether it's what we saw here in central with the science park sell side with cyber port. What are sort of the you know these areas you're supposed to be breeding these homegrown unicorns
segments.zh: 无论是中环的科学园还是数码港，这些区域本应培育本土独角兽

segments.en: But it seems like these areas are more about building high rises and apartments here right now. What would determine the success of the northern metropolis?
segments.zh: 但现在看来这些区域更多是在建高楼和住宅。什么将决定北部都会区的成败？

segments.en: So execution risk is real. What we should think about is how we're able to entice enterprise occupancy in Hong Kong
segments.zh: 执行风险确实存在。我们要思考的是如何吸引企业入驻香港

segments.en: So the reason tender results we thought is quite encouraging at least we have JD as an anchor tenant. And JD itself is going to occupy the space
segments.zh: 我们认为招标结果相当令人鼓舞，至少京东作为锚定租户。京东本身将入驻该空间

segments.en: Much earlier than the initial agreement. So that's a vote of confidence. What we think it's very important for the next step is the monitor what actually goes on in the university town tender
segments.zh: 比最初协议早得多。这是信心票。我们认为下一步非常重要的是关注大学城招标的实际进展

segments.en: And the results of that is expected to be out year-end. So let's focus on talent inflow and let's focus on what other enterprises are likely to occupy and establish presence in Hong Kong
segments.zh: 结果预计年底公布。所以让我们关注人才流入，关注还有哪些企业可能入驻并立足香港
